case.caseTitle: Diesel overfill of tank T-101 during night transfer
case.initialDescription: During a night ship-to-tank transfer, diesel overflowed from tank T-101 into bund B-1. About 14 m³ was contained in the bund and recovered; no injuries and no off-site release.
case.refinedDescription: The transfer was not stopped because the level gauge LT-101 froze at 78 % and the single night-shift operator, busy with a ship arrival, did not cross-check the level. The independent high-high trip LSHH-101 failed because its float was seized; proof testing had dropped out of the maintenance system. The independent alarm LAH-102 was probably missed in an alarm flood (still being confirmed).

events.text: Diesel overflowed from tank T-101 into the bund during a night transfer

conditions.text: E-01 Ship-to-tank transfer into T-101 under way (demand on the overfill controls)
E-04 LT-101 servo gauge displacer stuck (frozen reading)
E-03 Level cross-check not done during the transfer
H-01 Single operator on night shift, also handling a ship arrival
E-06 LSHH-101 level switch failed on demand (float stuck)

contributingFactors.text: Single operator on night shift, also handling a ship arrival

rootCauses.text: LSHH-101 level switch failed on demand (float stuck) — Proof testing of tank overfill switches dropped from the CMMS schedule; no tracking of overdue SIS tests.

keyLearnings.text: Independent overfill protection is only independent if it is tested.
Manning changes need a management-of-change review that covers peak workload, such as a ship arrival during a transfer.

correctiveActions.finding: Addresses E-06: LSHH-101 level switch failed on demand (float stuck)
correctiveActions.action: Restore proof testing of all tank overfill switches (LSHH) in the CMMS and test LSHH-101/201/301 within 14 days.

correctiveActions.finding: Addresses E-06: LSHH-101 level switch failed on demand (float stuck)
correctiveActions.action: Add an overdue-SIS-test KPI to the monthly management review.

correctiveActions.finding: Addresses E-04: LT-101 servo gauge displacer stuck (frozen reading)
correctiveActions.action: Add servo gauge LT-101 (and sister gauges) to the planned maintenance system with a 6-monthly displacer inspection.

correctiveActions.finding: Addresses E-03: Level cross-check not done during the transfer
correctiveActions.action: Add a level cross-check hold point (radar vs servo, at 85 % and 95 %) to the transfer procedure.

correctiveActions.finding: Addresses H-01: Single operator on night shift, also handling a ship arrival
correctiveActions.action: Carry out a management-of-change review of single-operator night manning during ship arrivals.

correctiveActions.finding: Addresses E-08: Control-room operator did not respond to the independent high-level alarm LAH-102
correctiveActions.action: Re-prioritise LAH-102 and other independent overfill alarms as high priority; rationalise nuisance alarms.
